Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J38/J38nB425.xml). Complete Record of Chan Master Jifei. Jifei Ruyi owns the retained deployment, finding the sovereign meeting yet not meeting and the ancestor knowing yet not knowing — two faceless fellows — with the no-sage knowing the sole honor.

Senses.Explanation: The sovereign's second pressing of the first ancestor — who is it that faces me? — raised, retold, oded, and answered on his behalf across the records. Wuzu Fayan raises the exchange at his evening teaching and throws it against Huineng — the Sixth Ancestor, asked who won Huangmei's purport, answered only that those who know the teaching won it and that he himself did not know the teaching — great and small ancestors, pressed, all not-knowing and not-understanding: why then grandchildren everywhere?; Zhongfeng Mingben picks up the case with the gap-toothed old monk's mud pellets, out to out-rich the eastern lands — and the Liang sovereign points the light-giving pearl at him, so he can only say he does not know; Hengchuan Rugong takes it into his own ode — vast and no sage, a true saying; who faces me? the heart not yet at rest — the original light shining through the ten directions from measureless ears to today; and Shiyu Mingfang grades the press itself: the sovereign's blood-seeing hand squeezed one more asking, and not-knowing, not-knowing, good as it is, saves only half — the river crossing and nine years of wall-facing cannot save the other, and the arm-severing Huike and the six generations and five houses have been holding up that other half ever since. Poshan Haiming tells it as the first ancestor's own errand — seeing great-vehicle roots in this land, crossing the sea to meet an emperor who loved the teaching and took the highest meaning for the ultimate — and the not-knowing that broke the meeting, the reed crossed, the wall faced; Fushi Tongxian turns it on the hearers: some, hearing it raised, force themselves into mastery — no cudgel turns them, no snare holds them, a stone guardian at the crossroads, nothing but a blockhead — while the true man keeps the idle ground all year, no sages above to long for, no beings below to save; Minshu Ruxiang rules the emperor eyed but did not see the cheek behind, the ancestor's words rang but hid their edge, the middle way open one thread and the sovereign missed it face to face — the empire can be shared out, ranks resigned, bare blades walked, the middle cannot be done; and Jifei Ruyi, picking up the case, finds the Liang sovereign meeting yet not meeting and the first ancestor knowing yet not knowing — two faceless fellows — with knowing the no-sage vastness the sole honor under heaven.
